name: VLR-Bench-ko
description: A Korean-language vision-and-language benchmark that evaluates multimodal understanding and reasoning (e.g., visual question answering and captioning) in Korean, testing models' ability to interpret images and produce Korean text responses.
evaluation_method: accuracy for QA/multiple-choice; text-similarity metrics (BLEU/CIDEr) for captioning
reputation: A targeted benchmark for Korean V&L research with limited but growing use in region-specific multimodal model evaluation.
